proof_body:
by
  intro s t a b ha hb
  constructor
  · rintro z ⟨x, hx, y, hy, rfl⟩
    have h₁ : x ≤ a := ha.1 hx
    have h₂ : y ≤ b := hb.1 hy
    linarith
  · intro c hc
    have h₁ : b ≤ c - a := by
      apply hb.2
      intro y hy
      have h₂ : a ≤ c - y := by
        apply ha.2
        intro x hx
        have h₃ : x + y ≤ c := hc ⟨x, hx, y, hy, rfl⟩
        linarith
      linarith
    linarith
target_source: ∀ (s t : Set ℝ) (a b : ℝ), IsLUB s a → IsLUB t b → IsLUB {z : ℝ | ∃ x ∈ s, ∃ y ∈ t, z = x + y} (a + b)
